# 开放：跨过围住所立者的步，所立者的总水平不上升，任何水平变化都使它下降；被围住的世界归于静止而不需要有限；生成不息需要不被围住的步 / Openness: across steps enclosed around what stands, the total standing never rises and every change of standing lowers it; an enclosed world comes to rest without being finite, and generation without end needs steps not enclosed

## 主张 Claim

每步立着的条件被不重复地列出时（Web.StandingCensus），称一步围住所立者，当某个不重复、跨过该步封闭的家族包含该步前后立着的每个条件（Flow.AroundStanding）。在平衡与耗散之下，跨过这样的步，所立者的总水平下降至少为取用该家族的形成数（standing_runs_down），所以不上升（standing_never_rises）；任何条件的水平上升或下降都使它下降（change_lowers）：上升被给予，而那里给予需要取用；下降被取用（fall_lowers_on）。所以从某步起每步都围住所立者时，没有条件的水平在任意晚的步变化（stills）。读于世界：有普查、每个关系项都体现、流平衡且耗散的世界，从某步起每步都围住所立者时，生成与退化都不复现（World.rests_around）；关系项的相等可判定时，被围住的步就围住所立者，所以从某步起每步都被围住即可（World.rests_enclosed）。这不需要有限。反过来读，这样的世界生成不息时，在任意晚的步有不被围住的步：与每个有限家族之外交换（World.generation_opens）。开放不能去掉：Handing 的两侧另外在每步从无限多个地关系项各取一个单位再还回，满足 Becoming.Premises 的全部八个前提，生成不息；没有一步被围住，所以只在被围住的步上约束的耗散在任何一步都不约束（World.exposed_world）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / Where what stands at each step is listed, each once (Web.StandingCensus), a step is enclosed around what stands when some family without repetition, closed across the step, holds every condition standing before or after it (Flow.AroundStanding). Under balance and dissipation, across such a step the total standing falls by at least the number of formations taking from that family (standing_runs_down), so it does not rise (standing_never_rises), and any condition's standing rising or falling lowers it (change_lowers): a rise is given to, and giving needs uptake there; a fall is taken from (fall_lowers_on). So where every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, no condition's standing changes at arbitrarily late steps (stills). Read of worlds: a world with a census whose relata are all embodied, with a balanced, dissipative flow, in which every step from some step on is enclosed around what stands, comes to rest: neither generation nor degeneration recurs (World.rests_around); where equality of relata is decided, an enclosed step is enclosed around what stands, so enclosure from some step on suffices (World.rests_enclosed). Finiteness is not needed. Read the other way, generation without end in such a world needs, at arbitrarily late steps, a step not enclosed: exchange beyond every finite family (World.generation_opens). Openness cannot be dropped: the sides of Handing, also taking a unit from each of infinitely many ground relata and giving it back at every step, meet all eight premises of Becoming.Premises and generate without end; no step is enclosed, so dissipation, which binds only at enclosed steps, binds at none (World.exposed_world). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Openness.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Openness.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 水平的规律（stills）：平衡；耗散；所立者的普查（每步立着的条件被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个立着）；从某步起每步都围住所立者。 / The standing law (stills): balance; dissipation; a census of what stands (the conditions standing at each step listed, each once, so finitely many stand at each step); every step from some step on enclosed around what stands.
- 读于世界（rests_around、rests_enclosed、generation_opens）：另加活动的普查与每个关系项都体现，二者一起给出所立者的普查；rests_enclosed 与 generation_opens 另要求关系项的相等可判定（核心是构造性的；经典地总是如此）。 / Read of worlds (rests_around, rests_enclosed, generation_opens): also a census of activity and every relatum embodied, which together give the census of what stands; rests_enclosed and generation_opens also need equality of relata to be decidable (the core is constructive; classically it always is).
- exposed_world 是关于一个具体世界的陈述，不加前提。 / exposed_world is a statement about a particular world, with no premise.

§30 的 rests 用有限使世界归于静止；本结果说明起作用的是被围住，不是有限。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在平衡与耗散之下，所立者的总水平是一个只降不升的量；每次生起（体现时就是开始作为条件而在）与每次止息（体现时就是不再作为条件而在）都使它下降，所以在一个被围住的展开中，变化只能有限多次。生成不息因此需要开放：在任意晚的步，与每个有限家族之外交换。这是 §17、§20 中家族层面的“开放”在世界层面的陈述，并且用变化的所立者列表而不是固定的家族。exposed 显示这一条件不能去掉：它满足全部八个前提，而由于没有一步被围住，耗散的前提在任何一步都不约束；它的总水平随世界不断上升。这是耗散的表示的一个已披露的特点（§22 的 Spray）：耗散只约束被围住的交换。“开放”“被围住”“所立者”的读法与名称是 AI 的表述，由 Ren 定；本结果不评价开放或静止。 / Section 30's rests brings a world to rest through finiteness; this result shows that enclosure, not finiteness, does the work. The author's reading (an AI argument): under balance and dissipation the total standing is a quantity that falls and never rises; every arising (for an embodied relatum, coming to stand) and every ceasing (for an embodied relatum, ceasing to stand) lowers it, so in an enclosed unfolding change happens only finitely often. Generation without end therefore needs openness: exchange beyond every finite family at arbitrarily late steps. This is the family-level openness of sections 17 and 20 stated of worlds, over the changing list of what stands rather than a fixed family. exposed shows that the condition cannot be dropped: it meets all eight premises, and since no step is enclosed, the premise of dissipation binds at none; its total standing keeps rising with the world. This is a disclosed feature of how dissipation is represented (section 22's Spray): dissipation binds only enclosed exchange. The readings and names of ‘openness’, ‘enclosed’ and ‘what stands’ are the AI's formulations and Ren's to choose; the result evaluates neither openness nor rest.
